'''Synox''' was a colorless, odorless, tasteless [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that was extremely [[Death/Legends|deadly]]. It was used by the [[GenoHaradan]] for assassination. [[Githany]] used it in her attempt to poison [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

===Description===
The effects of Synox occurred very quickly, and was almost undetectable at first. It caused vicious gut pains, intense fatigue and internal hemorrhaging, especially around the eyes and nose. If unchecked, it quickly caused [[death]]. It was also known to cause a discolored complexion and swelling of the tongue. There was also a known antidote, which was used by [[Caleb]] to heal Darth Bane.  

===History===
The poison was used by the GenoHaradan for assassination. It was also used by Githany, who coated her lips in the poison to kill Darth Bane. Despite taking the antidote beforehand, Githany still felt dizziness from the exposure to the poison. Darth Bane was later cured by the healer [[Caleb]].
